findings.title: Absolute SLSQP stopping falsely rejects a strictly feasible zero-residual dipole
findings.consequence: With S=diag(0.001,-0.001,0), O=0, d_obs=(0.001,0,0), e_d=0.002, Dmax=0.01 and B=1e-8, the optimizer returns the starting d_obs and score 224.26870610147634 / incompatible. The explicit d=0 witness lies strictly inside both balls and has exactly zero residual; the true profiled score is zero.
findings.cause: Unscaled squared objective/constraints, absolute ftol and finite-difference gradients are accepted without a verified optimality residual.

findings.title: Squared-norm underflow turns a nonzero residual into exact membership and nonzero S into S=0
findings.consequence: At S=0, O=(1e-200,0,0,0,0,0,0), d_obs=0 and B=0, the exact residual norm is 1e-200 but the function returns residual_squared=0, score=0, compatible=true. Replacing S by diag(1e-200,-1e-200,0) also incorrectly selects S_ZERO_DIRECT_MEMBERSHIP. These finite values are representable and violate the promised small-nonzero-S and zero-budget domains.
findings.cause: Branching on np.linalg.norm(S)==0 and using sqrt(r@r) for membership allow representational underflow to become a physical verdict.

Retain the existing 0.8/0.8 rejection, correlated covariance propagation, chart/vertex and source units controls.
